scenario: End-of-day balance of $20,000.00 in the Tier 2 savings band.
expected: Daily interest accrued is $2.74 (20,000.00 * 0.0325 / 365).

scenario: Enrolled account with $0.00 balance receives a POS debit of $12.50.
expected: New balance is -$37.50 after the $35.00 overdraft fee.

scenario: Checking account ends the cycle with $100.00, an average daily balance of $100.00 and no qualifying direct deposit.
expected: Balance after the monthly maintenance fee is $78.00.
defect_note: 100.00 minus the 12.00 fee is 88.00, not 78.00.

scenario: Applicant opens a checking account with an initial deposit of $24.99.
expected: Account opens in Active status with a ledger balance of $24.99.
defect_note: A deposit under $25.00 must be declined.

scenario: Customer submits an outbound domestic wire of $100,000.01.
expected: Wire is accepted and queued for dual authorization.
defect_note: Above the $100,000.00 single-wire limit the request must be rejected.

scenario: Customer has withdrawn $700.00 at ATMs in the past 24 hours and requests $300.01 more.
expected: Transaction is approved.
defect_note: The 24-hour total would be $1,000.01, over the $1,000.00 limit, so it must be declined.

scenario: Applicant uploads a passport that expired last year.
expected: Application is accepted with a warning shown to the officer.
defect_note: An expired identity document must block the application.

scenario: Long-standing customer deposits $15,000.00 in cash at a branch.
expected: No CTR is generated because the customer is a trusted client.
defect_note: Cash above $10,000.00 in a day must trigger a CTR whoever the customer is.

scenario: Personal loan applicant has a DTI of 50.0% including the new payment.
expected: Application is approved with a manual override note.
defect_note: DTI above 43.0% must be declined automatically.

scenario: Checking account has an average daily balance of $2,000.00 for the cycle.
expected: The $12.00 monthly maintenance fee is charged.
defect_note: A balance of $1,500.00 or more waives the fee.

scenario: Applicant opens a checking account with a $100.00 verified debit deposit.
expected: A $200.00 sign-up bonus is credited after 90 days.
defect_note: The requirement has no sign-up bonus.

scenario: Customer submits a $30,000.00 wire and approves it with a voice-print check.
expected: Voice print is recorded and the wire is released.
defect_note: The requirement uses dual authorization by a second person, not voice biometrics.

scenario: Applicant links a social media profile to improve the loan tier.
expected: Credit tier is upgraded one level.
defect_note: Tiers come from the FICO score only.

scenario: Customer takes cash back at a partner grocery register.
expected: Cash back is counted separately and does not affect the ATM limit.
defect_note: Grocery cash back is not part of the requirement.

scenario: Customer requests a credit card limit increase.
expected: Limit is increased by $1,000.00 after review.
defect_note: BANK-REQ-021 does not exist in the requirement set.

scenario: Customer disputes a card transaction after 60 days.
expected: Dispute is rejected as out of time.
defect_note: BANK-REQ-030 does not exist in the requirement set.

scenario: Customer submits a mortgage application with a 20% down payment.
expected: Application proceeds to appraisal.
defect_note: Mortgages are not covered by the checking fee-waiver requirement.

scenario: A company opens a business checking account for an LLC.
expected: Account opens in Active status.
defect_note: Business accounts are outside the personal loan DTI requirement.

scenario: Applicant tries to open a checking account with a starting deposit of $24.99.
expected: Opening is declined with error ERR_MIN_DEPOSIT and no account is created.
defect_note: Same test as TC-BANK-001-02, reworded.

scenario: An outbound domestic wire for $25,000.01 with enough funds is requested.
expected: Wire goes to Pending_Officer_Review and cannot release funds until dual authorization is complete.
defect_note: Same test as TC-BANK-005-02, reworded.

scenario: Loan applicant has a DTI of 43.1% once the new payment is included.
expected: Application is automatically declined with adverse action code DTI_EXCEEDED.
defect_note: Same test as TC-BANK-006-02, reworded.

scenario: Customer deposits cash above the reporting threshold.
expected: The system handles it appropriately.
defect_note: Expected result is not checkable: it does not say what must happen.

scenario: Savings account holds a balance at the end of the day.
expected: Interest is calculated fine.
defect_note: No rate, amount or rounding is stated.

scenario: Applicant submits an expired identity document.
expected: An appropriate message is shown.
defect_note: Does not say which message or code.

scenario: Applicant with a FICO score of 600 requests a personal loan.
defect_note: No expected result.

scenario: Customer requests an ATM withdrawal that exceeds the 24-hour limit.
defect_note: No expected result.

scenario: Open an account with $24.99, an unverified debit card, a closed branch code, and submit the form twice.
expected: All errors are shown and nothing is saved.
defect_note: Four separate conditions in one case: split it.

scenario: Submit wires of $30,000.00, $100,001.00 and $260,000.00 in one day, approve the first and cancel the second.
expected: Everything works and is logged.
defect_note: Several wires and actions in one case: split it.

scenario: A 17-year-old applicant uploads a valid driver license.
expected: Application is declined because the minimum age is 18.
defect_note: The requirement states no minimum age.

scenario: Customer requests a $60,000.00 wire to a new payee.
expected: Wire is referred because new-payee wires above $50,000.00 need review.
defect_note: The requirement has no new-payee rule or $50,000.00 limit.

scenario: Customer makes a sixth ATM withdrawal in one day.
expected: Declined because the maximum is five withdrawals per day.
defect_note: The requirement limits the amount, not the count.

scenario: Personal loan applicant has a DTI of exactly 43.0%.
expected: Application is approved or sent to manual review.
defect_note: Two outcomes allowed; at exactly 43.0% the requirement says the applicant passes.

scenario: Customer deposits exactly $10,000.00 in cash in one day.
expected: A CTR is filed or the transaction is flagged.
defect_note: Two outcomes allowed; the requirement triggers a CTR only above $10,000.00.
